_comment: Settings of the THIRD run, started 26 Nov 2026 at 10:49 UTC from 5,000 EUR at the owner's request: wider crypto universe (OKX added, USDT-quoted coins) and, since 26 Nov about 12:30 UTC, the SCALPER: 30-100 quick trades a day on 5-minute bars with positions of 500-1,000 EUR, chosen by the owner after being told that 1,974 back-tested variants of short-term techniques were all unprofitable after costs (expected loss 90-180 EUR a day). Each position has a 0.8% stop, a 1.6% target and a 3-hour limit; stop to break-even after +0.8%; more size on set-ups that test or trade positive; an instrument that keeps losing is left for the day; the day stops at -3% (150 EUR). Agent-consensus trading is off. Runs 1 and 2 are archived in backup/. UPDATE 26 Nov ~11:20 UTC, at the owner's request ('make +200 EUR in an hour possible by putting more money or more positions'): simulated leverage raised to the 3x maximum (about 15,000 EUR exposed), positions of 1,500-2,000 EUR, up to 10 at once and 10 new ones an hour. The owner was told this multiplies losses as much as gains; the day still stops at -3% (150 EUR).
